jordan (oncall): Hey team — heads up I'm dropping early today, need coverage confirmed for the 21:00-01:00 UTC window. Primary/secondary? Also want to validate the DB failover runbook pointer before I handoff.

maria - infra: I can take primary 21:00-23:00, samir can be secondary. I need someone to own the latter half (23:00-01:00).

samir - platform: I can pick 23:00-01:00 as primary if that helps. I'll stay reachable for slow queries and routing problems.

jordan (oncall): Perfect — so final: maria primary 21:00-23:00, samir primary 23:00-01:00, lindsey on shadow/backstop. I'll do a short handoff checklist in 10.

lindsey (eng-sre): I can be the escalation for any on-call paging that needs an exec-level ack or incident declaration. Please page me directly if P1 > 15m unack or customer-facing outage.

incident-bot: NOTE: New handoff thread started by jordan (oncall) at 1769204821. Use `/inc handoff` to attach the schedule.

jordan (oncall): Quick reminders for paging and escalation — please follow these rules tonight:
- Page primary for alerts (PD primary schedule).
- If no ack in 10 minutes, escalate to secondary.
- If still unacked after 5 more minutes (total 15), page lindsey and mark Incident Severity in the incident bot.
- If customer-facing errors (500s affecting >5% of requests) — declare incident, notify support and PM on-call.

maria - infra: Adding runbook links and run commands I use for DB failover: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/db-failover (link)

maria - infra: DB failover checklist snippet:
```
1) Check replicas health: `pg_isready` / `replica_status`
2) Promote replica: `switchover promote --target replica-3`
3) Update routing: `kubectl patch svc inference --patch '{"spec":{"selector":{"primary":"replica-3"}}}'`
4) Validate: smoke test against /health and run quick gen-100 prompt
```

samir - platform: Also: remember KV cache warming step post-failover. Add a 2-min warm-up job: `/tools/cache-warm --model rdx-13b --prefixes /prompts/critical`

jordan (oncall): Paging matrix (copy into your notes):
- SEV1 (customer-down): Page PD primary + slack #prod-pager immediately. If no ack in 10m -> PD secondary -> 5m later -> lindsey + execs.
- SEV2 (degraded performance): Page PD primary, wait 15m; if persists, escalate to secondary then on-call lead.
- SEV3 (minor/errors): Create ticket and notify next-day on-call unless customer reports impact.

lindsey (eng-sre): One more: if there's unclear blast radius, set a temporary status page banner and notify CSMs. I can own that if I'm paged.

ops-rotations: Reminder: update the on-call calendar after handoff and run `/inc handoff complete` in this thread to close the rotation.

jordan (oncall): I'll post the final short-form handoff now:
- Coverage: 21:00-23:00 maria (primary), 23:00-01:00 samir (primary), lindsey (secondary/backstop)
- On-call PD rotations: follow PD schedule attached in calendar
- Runbooks: db-failover + svc-routing + cache-warm links above
- Escalation thresholds: 10m primary ack -> escalate to secondary, 15m total -> page lindsey + declare incident if customer-facing
- Customer-impact check: if >=5% error rate OR >3 support tickets in 10m -> mark SEV1 and notify support/PMs

jordan (oncall): handing off now — leaving my phone with DND off until 21:10 to triage any immediate handover questions. Thanks! :pray:

samir - platform: Got it, will monitor for the late shift. If anything unclear ping me on DMs.

maria - infra: Thanks Jordan — will ack in this thread when I start at 21:00. :white_check_mark:
